scope: Full-portfolio Opus calibration of every skill in this repo not already covered by SKILL-CALIBRATION-OPUS-SAMPLE-LATEST.json (which holds copyright-scan).
methodology: Same A/B methodology as the Sonnet runs. Arm A: Opus sub-agent solves the task cold, no SKILL.md access. Arm B: Opus sub-agent reads .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and follows it. Token usage from harness's per-sub-agent usage.total_tokens — input + output + cache_creation; cache_read excluded. N=1 per skill per arm. Clean re-baseline 2026-05-26 in fresh isolated worktrees with simultaneous arm A + arm B dispatch — eliminates artifact-contamination risk from the original 2026-05-25/26 re-dispatches.
